description:
Second sweep of /tree feature parity against upstream pi-coding-agent.

## Background

opi-ce3 (now closed) addressed the four structural chrome gaps (header borders, hints, search field, count badge). This epic captures the remaining gaps found in a thorough side-by-side comparison (2026-05-06) running both programs in tmux.

## Scope

### Rendering / color gaps
- All tree entries render as plain text; upstream applies extensive ANSI styling
- toolResult entries show [toolName] instead of formatted [read: ~/path], [bash: cmd], etc.
- Compaction entries show summary text instead of [compaction: Nk tokens] using tokensBefore
- session_info entries show 'session info' instead of [title: name]
- CustomMessage entries fall through to '[entry]' catch-all

### Feature gaps  
- Node folding: no fold/unfold state, no fold markers (⊞/⊟), no branch-segment navigation
- Label editing: shift+L opens inline LabelInput modal (not implemented)
- Label timestamp toggle: shift+T toggles label timestamps in entries + (N/N) [+label time] suffix

### Navigation / interaction gaps
- Windowed display: all filtered nodes rendered; upstream shows only maxVisibleLines centered on selection
- maxVisibleLines: hardcoded 20; should be max(5, floor(terminalHeight / 2))
- Escape when search is active should clear search query before closing the overlay
- Up/down navigation clamps at boundaries; upstream wraps around (circular)
- ctrl+left and ctrl+right not registered as page-up/page-down aliases
